headline: Quincy go top without a conference defeat
dek: Quincy's win over Illinois Springfield on Wednesday lifted them above Maryville and Drury, both of whom have a match in hand. Their season reads five wins, three draws and one defeat, eighteen goals scored and eight conceded; the defeat came in their first match, at Wisconsin-Parkside, and nobody has beaten them since.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist's twenty-eight goals exceed what the four lowest-scoring programmes have managed between them, but the bar has not moved since Maryville's afternoon against them: they were held scoreless by Missouri S&T on Wednesday while Maryville scored again at Upper Iowa.

wire.line: Lincoln are the last side in the conference without a defeat, and they got there by beating Southwest Baptist.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no published result, and both are Drury's: at home to Evangel and away at Wash U.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lincoln remain the only programme in the conference yet to lose: four wins and three draws, thirteen goals scored and six conceded, the fourth win coming at Rockhurst on Wednesday.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Missouri S&T have not drawn a match this season: six wins and two defeats, nineteen goals scored and nine conceded.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Truman have scored fourteen goals and conceded seventeen, and Jacob Panagos has eight of the fourteen from nineteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Asgrimur Vidisson has made thirty-eight saves for Maryville and conceded nine, a save percentage of .809.

last_match.line: Lincoln have still not lost to anyone this season; Rockhurst have not scored at home in conference play since beating Indianapolis on opening weekend.

next_match.line: Maryville have won every home match they have played this season; Missouri S&T's only away defeat came at Quincy, the side now above both of them.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
